{
  "name": "prayer-times",
  "version": "1.1.2",
  "description": "The next Muslim prayer time under Claude Code's prompt, a gentle reminder at adhan, and a pane with today's sky, the timetable, a weekly prayer tracker and the Qibla. Calculated on your machine; no network.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Mohamed Ibrahim",
    "url": "https://mkbuilds.dev"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/mkbuilds4/mods/tree/main/plugins/prayer-times",
  "license": "MIT AND LGPL-3.0-only",
  "keywords": [
    "prayer",
    "salah",
    "islam",
    "adhan",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "latitude": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Latitude",
      "description": "Your latitude in degrees (north positive). 0 means: guess from your time zone.",
      "default": 0
    },
    "longitude": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Longitude",
      "description": "Your longitude in degrees (east positive, west negative). 0 means: guess from your time zone.",
      "default": 0
    },
    "place": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Place name",
      "description": "What to call your location in the pane, such as Brooklyn. Optional.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "method": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Calculation method",
      "description": "auto picks the method most used in your time zone's region.",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "ISNA",
        "MWL",
        "Egyptian",
        "UmmAlQura",
        "Karachi"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "asr": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Asr",
      "description": "Standard (Shafi'i, Maliki, Hanbali) or Hanafi.",
      "options": [
        "Standard",
        "Hanafi"
      ],
      "default": "Standard"
    },
    "sound": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "At adhan",
      "description": "A soft chime, a spoken reminder, or nothing.",
      "options": [
        "chime",
        "voice",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "chime"
    }
  }
}
